films.title: Cold Eyes
films.overview: Ha Yoon-ju becomes the newest member of a unit within the Korean Police Forces Special Crime Department that specializes in surveillance activities on high-profile criminals. She teams up with Hwang Sang-jun, the veteran leader of the unit, and tries to track down James who is the cold-hearted leader of an armed criminal organization.

films.title: Master
films.overview: Korea’s biggest network marketing scam reveals a far greater network of corruption and conspiracy lurking underneath.
